scoring_justification: Full recompute of Boltzmann transport from raw intermediate artifacts not feasible in lightweight checker; scoring structural properties (monotonicity, ordering, sign) that match the paper's reported trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Structural constraints derived from the paper's Fig. 3 and text: family ordering, monotonic on‑conductance and mobility, positive slope, 0<β<1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3 and main text description of familial behavior and temperature dependence.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's conclusions: 3j families, linear width increase, G_on ∝ 1/T^β with β~<1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The constraints are literal restatements of the paper's own claims and are used only for structural consistency checks; no numeric gold values beyond these relational constraints are needed.

required.on_conductance: array of arrays of floats (μS), dimension widths × temperatures
required.peak_mobility: array of arrays of floats (cm²/V·s), dimension widths × temperatures
required.width_slope: float (slope of on_conductance vs width at 300 K, μS/dimer-row)
required.family_ordering: string describing on-conductance ordering among families, e.g. 'family_a > family_b > family_c'

outputs.description: Agent's computed transport properties for armchair graphene nanoribbons. The structural_audit checks on_conductance ordering with width (monotonic increase), family ordering (must be a valid > separated ordering of 3j, 3j-1, 3j+1), width_slope > 0, and 0 < β < 1.

output_contract.notes: The on_conductance values are to be extracted at the threshold carrier density n = 2/(h v_F). The absolute values may differ due to implementation details; structural trends (ordering, sign of slope, beta range) are the primary check. The family ordering for widths 12 (3j), 10 (3j+1), 11 (3j-1) must be assessed.

steps.description: Validate structural properties: family ordering string, monotonic on_conductance and peak_mobility with width at 300 K, positive width_slope, and 0 < β < 1.
